##### Project general facts

The Cape by Al Barari is a residential ensemble of three contemporary low-rise buildings, each rising from a ground floor to eight residential floors. Designed to blend with the surrounding landscape, the architecture uses soft edges, organic forms, earthy tones and expansive panoramic glazing to echo the natural rhythm of water and gardens. The project offers a limited collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, each planned to capture natural light, open views and a calm sense of space.

Shared amenities are designed around wellness, family life and connection. Residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool and a separate family pool, set among landscaped courtyards that offer quiet places to relax outdoors. Wellness treatment rooms and a state-of-the-art gym support an active and balanced routine, while a coworking lounge provides a calm setting for focused work. A multipurpose rooftop lounge and a dedicated kids' club complete a lifestyle that nurtures privacy, community and peace.

Interiors are inspired by the beauty of simplicity and the elegance of natural materials. Generous layouts, soft neutral tones and textured finishes create warm, open spaces, while expansive terraces extend living areas outdoors and blur the line between inside and out. Kitchens feature quality cabinetry and refined countertops with fitted appliances, and bathrooms are finished with feature walls and natural tiles. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Barari is Dubai's original nature-led community, a living garden of more than half a million trees and plants, meandering waterways, lakes and shaded pathways. The community combines exclusive residences with wellness and leisure destinations such as The Bay Health Club, Heart and Soul Spa and Club Emelle with its padel courts and bowling lanes, alongside The Farm restaurant and The Mill Cafe and Bakery.

A direct underpass connects the community with Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, placing Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai International Airport within easy reach. Dubai Hills Mall and Global Village are a short drive away, and schools and nurseries lie close to the community. Families also benefit from the Al Barari Playground, Petitz Kids Club and a family arcade.

Al Barari is a freehold community that appeals to families and buyers seeking privacy, greenery and space close to the city centre. Low-density planning, an established lifestyle offer and a limited supply of new homes in the area support strong demand from end users. Its reputation as one of Dubai's most distinctive green addresses underpins long-term value for investors and owner-occupiers alike.
